Variants.Content: House Fell, based in Fallwood, is an ancient vassal between the Stormlands' interior and the coastal road. The woodlands, farms and mountain roads around Fallwood City allow the family to shoulder the responsibilities of wood, food, knights and checkpoints at the same time; Fell's territory is not as grand as Storm's End, but it can provide a reliable transit and stop when the stormland princes are mobilized. A family's reputation is often illuminated by the martial names of knights such as Silver Ax Fell, but local lords cannot maintain castles with just an axe. The real family assets are still woodland, tenants, horses and roads built by generations.

The nobles of the Stormlands regard Fell as a local family with a warrior tradition, and they will also calculate the value of the roads and forest products in Fallwood City. The silver ax can make a knight famous, and whether the family can keep the path will determine whether this reputation has roots.

The carpenters, farmers and soldiers of Luomu City knew that the ax could not only chop down enemies, but also chop wood to build houses. If the lord only uses it as a weapon, the woodland will lose its livelihood; if the lord knows how to make the blade serve the castle and the village, Fell's ax will be truly useful.
Entry Fell Entry Fell The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
Entry Fell Entry Fell Family reputation ultimately comes down to specific people and specific orders.
Entry Fell Entry Fell The ancestors of a family can be praised, or they can become a shackles for future generations; the older the bloodline, the more old debts the successors are required to bear.
Entry Fell Entry Fell They may not remember the complete family tree, but they remember which family opened a granary in the winter and which family drove the refugees back into the snow.
